tasks.goal: Navigate between the standalone kiosk screen and flanking monitor workstations, wiping contact surfaces under teleop supervision.
tasks.terrain: Hospital corridor floor outside the kiosk bay; wheelchair-access clearance around kiosk base; cable trays at workstation feet.
success: All 3 surfaces (kiosk screen, 2 monitors) visited in <8 min
Wipe contact force 2-5 N on each surface
Zero collisions logged on /scan <0.2 m
Task report JSONL emitted
safety_stops: E-stop on human within 0.5 m
Stop if tilt >15 deg
Stop on wheel current spike >150% nominal
Halt if kiosk screen in active use by visitor
tasks.human_in_loop: Clinic staff approve wipe sequence and confirm each surface is visibly clean before task close.

tasks.goal: Orbit the suspended 4D injury hologram at patient-eye height while carrying a calibration target, syncing poses to Imaging AI.
tasks.terrain: Flat imaging-room floor; low-profile floor projector plinth at hologram center; doctor and patient walking the display circumference.
success: Circular orbit r=1.5 m ±0.1 m completed in <90 s
Target pose jitter <2 cm RMS
No entry into 1 m hologram exclusion cylinder
Sync timestamps matched to Imaging AI clock within 50 ms
safety_stops: Stop if human within 0.8 m of robot
Stop on plinth contact detection
E-stop from room operator pendant
Stop if projector plinth marker lost for >1 s
tasks.human_in_loop: Radiographer approves orbit radius and start/stop of each calibration pass.

tasks.goal: Physically mirror the VR molecule editor: place tracked props at lab bench slots as the Scientist Assistant Avatar updates molecule state.
tasks.terrain: Lab bench surface 0.9 m height; prop bins along pine-window wall; neighbouring pipette racks as obstacles.
success: 10 props placed to correct slots with <5 mm positional error
Zero dropped props
Gripper force <20 N throughout
Molecule state mirror latency <100 ms per placement
safety_stops: Stop on wrench anomaly >40 N
Stop if any human within 0.6 m of arm envelope
Reflex stop on unexpected prop slip
Halt on Scientist Assistant Avatar disconnect
tasks.human_in_loop: Chemist approves prop-to-slot mapping and pauses arm before any prop swap.

tasks.goal: Escort arriving guests from office door to consultation desk while the Office AI Avatar converses, maintaining guide position and clearance.
tasks.terrain: Office carpet with threshold strip at doorway; consultation desk, seating cluster, and planter obstacles; Brunnsviken-side glazing (reflective, lidar-noisy).
success: Door-to-desk route completed in <120 s
Guide offset 1.0 m ±0.3 m from guest
Zero contacts; min clearance 0.5 m
Escort state transitions logged (door/guide/arrive)
safety_stops: Stop if guest falls behind >2.5 m
Stop on any person within 0.5 m other than guest
E-stop on stair/threshold anomaly
Stop on reflective-glass mislocalization (covariance spike)
tasks.human_in_loop: Practitioner approves escort route and greets guest at desk to close the task.

tasks.goal: Haul calibrated imaging phantoms from the lakeside loading bay through pine forest path to the 4D Imaging Room service entrance.
tasks.terrain: Forest path between Brunnsviken lake and hospital: gravel, pine root ruts, wet patches near lake edge; ramp to service entrance.
success: Route 400 m completed in <15 min
Payload within 40 kg, load cell stable ±10%
No wheel slip event >2 s
Ramp ascent without rollback >0.2 m
safety_stops: Stop on roll angle >15 deg
Stop near lake edge <1 m geofence
Halt on GPS accuracy >2 m HDOP
E-stop from escort operator
tasks.human_in_loop: Logistics staff verify payload lashing before departure and receive at the service entrance.

tasks.goal: Fly a low-altitude thermal sweep of the kiosk electronics bay and monitor backs, flagging hotspots for maintenance.
tasks.terrain: Indoor kiosk bay: ceiling fixtures at 3 m, monitor arms protruding, HVAC draft from hospital lobby doors.
success: Full bay sweep in <6 min on one battery
Thermal map covers 95% of electronics bay panels
Hotspots >60 C flagged with <10 cm localization
Min clearance 0.3 m from all fixtures
safety_stops: Land immediately if battery <3.3 V
Land if any person enters the bay
Stop on pose estimate loss >0.5 s
Return-to-pad on HVAC gust >4 m/s
tasks.human_in_loop: Maintenance technician approves flight volume and confirms each flagged hotspot before work order.
